ORDER OF THE COMMISSION 
 
 Ind. Code ch . 8-1-26 provides t he procedure for the Indiana Utility Regulatory 
Commission’s Pipeline Safety Division (“Division”) to find violations of said chapter. Upon 
review of those findings, the Indiana Underground Plant Protection Advisory Committee 
(“Advisory Committee”) reviews those recommendations and recommends civil penalties in the 
Case.   
 
The Cases received pursuant to Ind . Code ch. 8-1-26 and ripe for Commission action are 
attached hereto and collectively referred to as the Advisory Committee Recommendations.  
 
Pursuant to statute, the Advisory Committee has submitted their recommendations to the 
Commission. The Commission UPHOLDS the findings of violations by the Pipeline Safety 
Division and APPROVES the recommendations of the Advisory Committee as listed on the 
attached pages. The Assistant General Counsel to the Division is directed to prepare and send 
notice to the parties advising them of the determination. 
 
Any approved civil penalties are due within 90 days of the date of this Order unless 
payment arrangements are made with the Secretary of the Commission.   
 
Any approved trainings must be completed no later than 180 days from the date of this 
Order or the alternative civil penalty noted in the attached recommendation is due.   
 
IT IS SO ORDERED. 
 
HUSTON, FREEMAN, KREVDA, AND OBER CONCUR; ZIEGNER ABSENT: 
 
APPROVED:

Dana Kosco

cd /tmp/r2run-zutwz0u2/data/text; cat > $TMPDIR/a.py <<'E'
import re,glob,collections
n=0;tot=0;c=collections.Counter();bad=[]
for f in sorted(glob.glob('*.txt')):
    pages=re.split(r'=== page \d+',open(f).read())[1:]
    for p in pages:
        m=re.search(r'recommends the following civil\s+penalty:?(.*)',p,re.S|re.I)
        if not m: continue
        tot+=1
        if p.count('recommends the following')>1: bad.append(f)
        rec=m.group(1)
        if re.search('ticket\s+escalation',rec,re.I):
            n+=1
            a=re.search(r'\$[\$\s]*([\d,\s]*\d)',rec)
            v=int(re.sub(r'[,\s]','',a.group(1))) if a else 0
            c[v]+=1
print(tot,n,c.most_common(),bad)
E
python3 -I $TMPDIR/a.py; grep -ic "ticket escalation" *.txt | awk -F: '{s+=$2}END{print s}'

content.text:
Of the 9,954 cases in the 58 orders, **446** have a recommendation containing "ticket escalation". The most common headline penalty among them is **$1,500**, which appears in 291 of the 446 cases.

I parsed every order's text, one case per page. I matched "ticket escalation" case-insensitively and allowed for it wrapping across a line break. A plain line-by-line search finds only 204 matching lines, so it undercounts. I took the headline penalty as the first dollar amount in the recommendation, using the stated rules for doubled "$" signs and spaces after commas.

Headline penalties among the 446 cases:

| Headline penalty | Cases |
|---|---|
| $1,500 | 291 |
| $3,000 | 56 |
| $5,000 | 47 |
| $3,500 | 23 |
| $4,000 | 15 |
| $4,500 | 11 |
| $1,000 | 2 |
| $6,000 | 1 |

I took the order year from the file names and assumed all 58 orders fall within 2021–2025. I did not check the order dates inside the files.
